verdict.rationale: ADK ships its own CLI for running agents outside any UI. `adk run` executes an agent from the terminal, `adk eval` runs evalsets against an agent, and `adk api_server` exposes agents over REST "for programmatic testing". Together these cover headless, scriptable automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline guidance (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, exit-code/non-interactive flags for `adk run`), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the API server in ADK to expose your agents through a REST API for programmatic testing
